description: This file defines a class PdfNullObject representing a null object within a PDF document. It includes constructors, a string override, and a method to write itself via a PdfWriter, aligning with PDF specifications for null objects.

classes.name: PdfNullObject
classes.description: Represents a PDF null object, typically used to denote the absence of a value in a PDF, conforming to the PDF specification.

methods.name: PdfNullObject()
methods.description: Default constructor for creating a null object without associating it with a document.

methods.name: PdfNullObject(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor that associates this null object with a specific PDF document.

methods.name: ToString()
methods.description: Returns the string 'null', representing this object in PDF syntax.

methods.name: WriteObject(PdfWriter writer)
methods.description: Serializes this null object into the PDF stream using the provided PdfWriter.
